 import { Endpoints } from "@octokit/types";
 
+type NormalizeRoute<R extends string> = R extends `${infer Prefix}:${infer Param}/${infer Rest}`

+  : R extends `${infer Prefix}:${infer Param}`
+  ? `${Prefix}{${Param}}`
+  : R;
+
+type Endpoint<R extends string> = R extends keyof Endpoints
+  ? Endpoints[R]
+  : NormalizeRoute<R> extends keyof Endpoints

- `npm run -s lint` passes.

- `git diff --check` passes.
